recent_items.summary: Packing a 3D volume into a token sequence is not merely long-sequence modeling. This is a general failure mode for attention over packed geometric data. We introduce PACK3D, a local-global attention operator that separates memory layout from attention geometry. recent_items.title: Geometry Matters in Packed 3D Attention
